global: A bowl of spicy ramen boasts a rich, orange-red broth. Topped with bean sprouts, minced meat, and spinach, it sits in a white bowl on a dark wooden table, lit warmly from above.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface and thin, clean rim showing faint brown residue stains.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, bean sprouts, minced meat, and greens, showing rich orange hue and glossy surface.
